IPCR.description: Imperfection Load (IPCR). A single imperfection-load record keyed by integer id; NATIONAL_CODE selects the code basis (0=Global, 1=China) and, for China, the CH_DATA block supplies the imperfection curvature parameters.

IMPNAME.description: Imperfection load case name (source buckling/analysis load case the imperfection shape is derived from).

LCNAME.description: Load case name resolved against ANALTYPE to look up the load case key.

ANALTYPE.description: Analysis type of the referenced load case. Case-insensitive.

DIR.description: Direction index for the imperfection load.

MINMAX.description: Min/Max mode of the imperfection value. Case-insensitive. Stored internally as index-1: MIN=-1, ALL=0, MAX=1.

NATIONAL_CODE.description: National code basis: 0=Global, 1=China. CH_DATA is only applied when the China code path is active.

CH_DATA.description: [NATIONAL_CODE=1 (China)] China-specific imperfection curvature data. Ignored on non-China builds/codes.

bELEM.description: Whether the imperfection is applied on an element basis.

bAUTOCALK.description: Auto-calculate the K factor; when false, dK is used.

dK.description: Manually specified K factor (used when bAUTOCALK is false).

bAUTOE0L.description: Auto-calculate the e0/L ratio; when false, dE0L is used.

dE0L.description: Manually specified e0/L ratio (used when bAUTOE0L is false).
